<!-- stormworks-research-gap:category:Electricity -->
This issue tracks explicit open questions in the [wiki](https://sw-wiki.maxsp.de/parts#electricity).

The quotations below preserve the scope of each source. A resource-only article can lack a formula that a separate native-code investigation has partly recovered. Reconcile those findings before treating every quoted item as wholly undecoded.

## Recorded gaps

**Practical behavior guidance**

> Electric units are internal; no conversion to joules or watts was recovered.

- [wiki/data/behavior.json](https://github.com/Chaoscaot/stormworks-wiki/blob/main/wiki/data/behavior.json), `/categories/3/limitations/0`

**Practical behavior guidance**

> ω is the component's internal speed state; how it maps to the RPS port and how the shaft link exchanges speed were not decoded.

- [wiki/data/behavior.json](https://github.com/Chaoscaot/stormworks-wiki/blob/main/wiki/data/behavior.json), `/categories/3/limitations/1`

**Practical behavior guidance**

> Motors and both starters draw through the same helper. It removes min(a × request, network charge) and returns the supplied fraction, where a = max(0, (300 − n) ÷ 300) × q comes from two node fields whose meaning was not recovered. A motor's step is scaled by that fraction, so starving it slows acceleration without changing the cost per unit of step. With infinite_batteries on, the helper returns 1 and takes nothing. Generators deposit regardless of that setting.

- [wiki/data/behavior.json](https://github.com/Chaoscaot/stormworks-wiki/blob/main/wiki/data/behavior.json), `/categories/3/sections/3/body`

**Practical behavior guidance**

> The speed unit of ω, the update rate and the shaft-link model were not recovered, so charge per update cannot yet be turned into charge per second or per unit of work. The shipped realtime file sets electric_consumption_scale to 0.01, but the release binary does not contain that name.

- [wiki/data/behavior.json](https://github.com/Chaoscaot/stormworks-wiki/blob/main/wiki/data/behavior.json), `/categories/3/sections/4/body`

## Completion criteria

- Recover the relevant routine or run a reproducible measurement against the identified game build.
- Record equations, units, bounds, assumptions and executable addresses or measurement inputs.
- Update the wiki guidance and its extractor, retaining citations and any remaining uncertainty.
- Add or update an interactive graph when the recovered formula supports one.
- Re-run the relevant source checks and website checks.
title: Electricity: decode remaining behavior and formulas
